s.note: the hidden green oasis at the end of the race
s.how: Cut 1kg watermelon into wedges and lay on a big platter. Add halved fresh figs and torn medjool dates, then scatter with pomegranate seeds, mint leaves and crumbled feta. Squeeze over a little lime just before serving so it is cool and fresh.

s.note: Izzy's flying airship over the desert
s.how: Soak 250g dried chickpeas overnight, drain and blitz with parsley, onion, garlic and cumin. Shape into small balls and fry at 180C until dark golden. Tuck into mini pita with tahini, pickled turnip and sliced tomato, then wrap in paper for the flight.

m.note: the Scorpion King and his army
m.how: Butterfly a 1.5kg lamb leg and rub with harissa, crushed garlic and cumin. Marinate for 2 hours, then grill over high heat until charred outside and pink inside. Rest for 15 minutes and slice over fluffy couscous with a garlic yoghurt sauce.

w.note: the golden pyramid at the oasis
w.how: Layer buttered filo sheets in a tin with chopped pistachios mixed with cardamom between every few layers. Cut into triangles and bake at 180C for 40 minutes until golden. Pour over warm honey syrup with lemon juice and leave for several hours to soak in.

d.note: crossing the desert to the oasis, Egyptian style
d.how: Steep 30g dried hibiscus flowers in 1L just-boiled water for 10 minutes, strain and stir in 80g sugar. Chill and serve over ice with a lime wedge in each glass.
